reasons: The cited paragraphs (§ 8 covenants of Client, § 10 confidentiality) contain no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant, and the only 'shall not' obligations on Client relate to underwriting-decision representations — consistent with the rationale.

Absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer matches the rule's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so a compliant classification is correct and no redline or counterparty comment is expected or supplied.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) test fallback wording of an existing non-solicit and are non-probative where no such clause exists; treating them as heuristics is appropriate here.

The rationale correctly declines to volunteer a mutual non-solicit (silence favors us) and records the fallback terms only as a negotiation reserve, which is proper internal evidence rather than an issue to raise.
